name: British Dyslexia Association
description: A UK charity providing information, training, signposting and a national helpline about dyslexia, dyscalculia and related neurodiversity questions.
intended_use: Find UK-focused dyslexia information, practical signposting and a route to the British Dyslexia Association helpline.
audience_or_context: People with dyslexia or dyscalculia, families, educators, employers and others seeking UK-focused information or support.
limitations: Helpline opening arrangements and availability can change, so current details should be checked on the official site.
The organisation can provide information and signposting but a listing here does not establish diagnosis, legal entitlement or effectiveness of any intervention.
cost_or_access_notes: The website and helpline information are publicly accessible; telephone call charges may depend on the caller's provider or plan.
conflicts_of_interest: The resource is described from the organisation's own current service pages; that establishes identity and access, not independent evidence of benefit.

provenance.method: British Dyslexia Association official helpline surface checked on 2026-08-28. Listing records current identity, audience, access route and limitations without converting first-party service descriptions into efficacy or diagnostic claims.
